title: "Current implementation and first use"

Search and copy 123 bundled typesetting commands and 10 snippets, and keep favorites offline. Plume is a reference tool; it does not compile LaTeX documents.

This page describes the October–November 2026 refinements. These source changes are not part of older development release downloads. Local checks are distinct from device, live-service and store acceptance.

## Build from a clean checkout

JDK 17, Android SDK 36 and build-tools 35.0.0. Set JAVA_HOME and ANDROID_HOME. A device/emulator is required to install. Open the existing ios/*.xcodeproj in a full Xcode installation for iOS.

```sh
cd android
./gradlew --no-daemon testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug bundleRelease
adb install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
```

These commands build from this source tree. Debug APKs are development artifacts; release bundles need private signing and device acceptance. A successful build is not a store submission.

## Use and verification

Read the [repository README](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-plume/blob/main/README.md) for the exact application workflow, privacy/storage behavior and platform differences. The [October refinement record](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-plume/blob/main/docs/refinement-2026-10.md) records findings, changes, observed checks, deferred work and the next release action.

Observed remote verification on 2026-10-31: [commit `c0b8183c4b35`](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-plume/commit/c0b8183c4b35e048f7b90d3da98d54c8d9dce1c1) passed [Android tests, lint, debug APK and unsigned release AAB packaging, plus the full unsigned iOS simulator build](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-plume/actions/runs/41200545481). Its [documentation build and deployment](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-plume/actions/runs/41200545528) also passed. Device journeys, live-service acceptance where applicable, release signing and store submission remain separate from these results.

The November 2 API 35/4 KiB emulator pass verified offline search, exact command copy/paste, favourite persistence, no-results recovery and the complete multiline snippet in Android's clipboard editor. Physical devices, iOS, API 36/16 KiB and full accessibility acceptance remain separate checks.
